## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.  
Fix the missing user backup before merge so the migration can recover legacy email values if the deploy is rolled back.

## Changes

The pull request adds SQLite migrations that drop `users.legacy_email` and `orders.coupon_code`. It adds a test for both column drops and preservation of coupon codes in the orders backup.

## Critical

- migrations/m0003_drop_legacy_email.py:7 — correctness — Back up users before dropping `legacy_email` — For a user created after migration 2 with `legacy_email = 'old@example.com'`, migration 3 deletes that value without copying it. `migrations/safety.py:4` says “each destructive migration first calls backup_table,” and the version 2 snapshot predates that row. — Operators cannot recover legacy email values added after migration 2 from the migration backups. — Fix: Call `backup_table(conn, "users", VERSION)` before the drop and extend `test_drop_retired_columns` to check the version 3 backup.
